name: Paarai
title: One of David's mighty warriors
summary: Paarai was an Arbite (from Arab) who is mentioned among David's thirty mighty warriors. He was one of the brave men who served King David with outstanding military skill. His name appears in the list of David's heroes in 2 Samuel, and he is also called Naarai in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's mighty men
keyEvents.description: Paarai the Arbite is listed among David's thirty mighty warriors, an elite group of soldiers who distinguished themselves in service to King David.

keyEvents.title: Parallel reference as Naarai
keyEvents.description: In the parallel list of David's heroes in Chronicles, he is mentioned as Naarai, son of Esbai, which provides additional information about his family background.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's elite force
keyEvents.description: As one of the Thirty, Paarai was part of a select group of warriors who formed the core of David's military leadership and protected the king in battle.

keyEvents.title: Service During David's Reign
keyEvents.description: Paarai served faithfully under David's rule over the united Israel, helping to secure and expand the kingdom through his military efforts.
